$comment: Single source of truth for the ids the JS product-action bus (dispatchMenuAction/useMenuAction) recognizes. Rust embeds this file and asserts that every id MENU_SPEC bridges from the native macOS menu bar is one of these — see menu_spec_tests.rs. The product-owned title bar's app menu (desktop-title-bar.tsx) dispatches the same ids on every platform, so the native bar and the title-bar menu run the same workflows.
